name: Kenaiah
title: Singer among the Levites
summary: Kenaiah was a Levite appointed as leader of the singing and the transport of the ark of the covenant during King David's reign. He played an important role in the musical worship service and in organizing the service of the Levites. His name means 'The Lord has established'.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Singer
keyEvents.description: Kenaiah was appointed leader of the Levitical singing because he was skilled in it. He led the singing when the ark of the covenant was carried.

keyEvents.title: Carrying the Ark of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Kenaiah supervised the transport of the ark and instructed the bearers, since he was skilled in this work.

keyEvents.title: The Ark Brought to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Kenaiah participated in the great procession when the ark of the covenant was brought up to Jerusalem with rejoicing, singing, and music.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Levites' Service
keyEvents.description: In the further organization of the Levites' service under David, Kenaiah and his sons were appointed as overseers and judges in external matters for Israel.

keyEvents.title: Service as Overseer
keyEvents.description: Kenaiah and his clan from the Izharites were given responsibility for administrative and legal tasks outside the temple service, to serve the king.
